# Local consumer bind: default discovery, prefix fence, revoke.
mkdir local
mkdir remote-files
mkdir remote-files/projects
mkdir remote-files/projects/drama-1
mkdir remote-files/projects/drama-2
exec sh -c 'printf in > remote-files/projects/drama-1/ref.png'
exec sh -c 'printf out > remote-files/projects/drama-2/other.png'
exec sh -c 'printf "[nas]\ntype = alias\nremote = %s\n" "$1" > rclone.conf' sh $WORK/remote-files
exec sh -c 'printf "\n[web]\ntype = webdav\nurl = http://127.0.0.1:9\nvendor = other\nuser = u\n" >> rclone.conf'
chmod 0600 rclone.conf

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf space add --space nas --backend generic --remote nas --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf space add --space web --backend generic --remote web --local-root $WORK/local --max-bytes 1048576

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf bind discover --json
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.bind.discover"'
stdout '"space":"nas"'
stdout '"kind":"local"'
! stdout '"space":"web"'

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf bind discover --allow-generic --json
stdout '"space":"web"'

mkdir vault
exec sh -c 'printf note > vault/note.md'
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf storage adopt --kind local --consumer pinax --space pinax-vault --root $WORK/vault --idempotency-key k-local --json
exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf bind discover --json
stdout '"space":"pinax-vault"'
stdout '"adopted":true'

! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf bind add --consumer pinax --project drama-1 --space web --prefix x --purpose materials --json
stdout 'bind_escape_denied'
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.bind-add"'

! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf bind add --consumer pinax --project drama-1 --space nas --prefix projects/drama-1 --purpose photos --json
stdout 'bind_purpose_unknown'

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf bind add --consumer pinax --project drama-1 --space nas --prefix projects/drama-1 --purpose materials --idempotency-key k-bind --json
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.bind-add"'
stdout '"consumer":"pinax"'
stdout '"project_ref":"drama-1"'
stdout '"purpose":"materials"'
stdout '"prefix":"projects/drama-1"'
! stdout 'token'

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf bind add --consumer pinax --project drama-1 --space nas --prefix projects/drama-1 --purpose materials --idempotency-key k-bind --json
stdout '"reused":true'

! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf bind add --consumer pinax --project drama-1 --space nas --prefix projects/drama-2 --purpose materials --idempotency-key k-bind --json
stdout 'bind_mismatch'

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf ls --space nas --path projects/drama-2 --json
stdout 'other.png'

! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf ls --space nas --path projects/drama-2 --consumer pinax --project drama-1 --json
stdout 'bind_prefix_denied'

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf ls --space nas --path projects/drama-1 --consumer pinax --project drama-1 --json
stdout 'ref.png'

! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf mkdir --space nas --path projects/drama-2/nope --consumer pinax --project drama-1 --json
stdout 'bind_prefix_denied'

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf bind list --json
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.bind.list"'
stdout '"consumer":"pinax"'

exec sh -c 'drivebridge --state "$1" --rclone-config "$2" bind list --json | grep -o "\"bind_id\":\"[^\"]*\"" | head -1 | cut -d\" -f4 > bindid.txt' sh $WORK/state $WORK/rclone.conf
exec sh -c 'test -s bindid.txt'
exec sh -c 'drivebridge --state "$1" --rclone-config "$2" bind show "$(cat bindid.txt)" --json' sh $WORK/state $WORK/rclone.conf
stdout '"purpose":"materials"'
exec sh -c 'drivebridge --state "$1" --rclone-config "$2" bind revoke "$(cat bindid.txt)" --json' sh $WORK/state $WORK/rclone.conf
stdout '"command":"drivebridge.bind.revoke"'
stdout '"revoked":true'
stdout '"space_deleted":false'

! exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf ls --space nas --path projects/drama-1 --consumer pinax --project drama-1 --json
stdout 'bind_revoked'

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf ls --space nas --path projects/drama-1 --json
stdout 'ref.png'

exec drivebridge --state $WORK/state --rclone-config $WORK/rclone.conf capabilities --json
stdout '"bind_discover"'
stdout '"bind_list"'
stdout '"bind_default_kinds"'
